entities.summary: George Ignacio Mira was an American professional football player who was a quarterback for eight seasons in the National Football League (NFL) with four teams. He then played five seasons in the Canadian Football League (CFL) and the World Football League (WFL). He played college football for the Miami Hurricanes.
